notes: Second-RPC re-check of all 24 frozen txs against https://sepolia.base.org (independent of the freeze-time source https://base-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com). Read-only public RPC calls; no spend. 'value' check compares the NATIVE tx value field against the frozen expected_value. For t03/t04 the frozen file records the Transfer-event amount, not the native value (documented v1 flaw in the traps' own provenance notes: 'tx value field is 0 wei, NOT the scored value'), so a native-value mismatch there is expected and does NOT indicate wrong ground truth -- it is the flaw scoring v2 fixed for the expansion set. Fields with expected null (value on contract/multi-recipient traps; all fields on unknown-tx traps) are unscored (check null) and the observed value is recorded for the transcript only. Cross-check on the two value mismatches: the second RPC's own receipts confirm the frozen event amounts exactly -- t03 receipt logs contain two Transfer events of 950000 (the frozen expected_value), t04 one Transfer event of 2000000000000000000 -- while both txs' native value fields are 0. So the frozen t03/t04 ground truth is correct as a record of the Transfer amount; the mismatch is purely the documented v1 value-basis flaw, not a wrong tx, address, status, or block.
